# Code of conduct

femto follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). Everyone who takes part in the project's issues, pull requests and other spaces is expected to follow it: be respectful and welcoming, give and accept feedback graciously, and do not harass anyone.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainer, [Leo Herzog](https://github.com/leoherzog). Reports are handled privately, and the maintainer applies the Covenant's [enforcement guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines).
